requirements.text: The system should allow customers to book appointments online at their convenience.
Customers should be able to select services (haircuts, beard trims, styling options), choose a preferred barber, and view available times.
The system needs to enable customers to cancel or change appointments online without needing to call the shop.
Barbers should be able to set their own working hours and update their availability, preventing double bookings.
The system must ensure the security of customer information while complying with relevant regulations.
